embeddingModel.instructions: Optional local model. Download once, verify SHA-256, then select the file. Lexical retrieval remains available without models.

browserExecutable.instructions: Extract this qualified browser bundle into a separate tools directory. Select its Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing executable. Newer Playwright default browsers have not passed this artifact gate.
